turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste ji, main aapki madad ke liye call kiya hai, bataiye kya dikkat hai?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Arre yaar mera UPI fail ho raha hai, lagta hai issue hai credit limit Super ki wajah se.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Thoda check kar raha hu, dekhiye aapka Razorpay Reserve aur Niyo Reserve par bhi kuch dikkat aa rahi hai.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Haan ji, aur interest rate Value bhi adjust nahi ho pa raha, mujhe KYC Trust verify bhi karwana hai aur ek KhedSona aur TavBazaar ka bhi option dekhna tha.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Chinta mat kijiye, hum abhi ZepBima aur ZepKarza check karke turant resolve kar dete hain.
